description: Bond spoken-word golden vector for @forgesworn/kenspeckle ./bond. Uses the frozen ECDH secret and pubkeys from bond.ecdh.v1.json. For each row, bondWords(secret, pubA, pubB, counter, { namespace }) MUST return { mine: aMine, theirs: aTheirs }, and the B seat (pubB, pubA) MUST return the mirror { mine: aTheirs, theirs: aMine }. Frozen against spoken-token internals (pair\0 context, wordlist): a dependency bump that changes any word changes every contact's words and must fail here. The signet:me rows are kenspeckle's own output with that namespace, not an independent signet-me capture.
